top_signals.title: China Sentences Official to Death for Spying for Foreign Power
top_signals.summary: China said it sentenced an official to death for spying for a foreign intelligence service, publicizing the case as a warning against leaking state secrets.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Thailand plans to ban exports of chemicals as it tackles pollution
top_signals.summary: The country will work with China and Myanmar to address elevated arsenic levels in its northern rivers.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Hackers exploit GL.iNet cloud flaw to infect routers, KVM devices
top_signals.summary: GL.iNet has confirmed that hackers exploited a vulnerability in its cloud remote management services to install custom malware on customers' routers and KVM devices, with some affected users reporting backdoors and reverse shells giving remote access to infected devices. [...]
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Half of wallets on Trump’s dinner list got tokens from non-US exchanges
top_signals.summary: Public Citizen traced 66 of 130 qualifying wallets to exchanges that restrict US users, raising questions over who is attending Trump’s memecoin dinner on Sunday.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.
